scope: Planck controller dynamics and input semantics; numerical checks of the declared proxy, not measurements of the lost controls.

tests.name: Default mechanics has inertia; ordinary target commands cannot teleport a shaft
Releasing a rotating shaft dissipates kinetic energy and comes to rest
Historical torque range and button spring sensitivity preserve limits and actuation
Home and End load the physical stops; reversal takes up finite coupling play
Press, hold and release yield one close edge and one return edge
A short tap completes one stroke; retriggering while down does not autofire
Disabling mechanics preserves angle, cancels a pending press and restores direct input
Fixed integration is independent of presentation frame chunks
Halving the step bounds angular trace differences and contact timing
Four-body controller cost fits a small fraction of a 60 Hz frame on this host

performance.host: Linux/Node; not M1 or browser FPS
